description: Server side of all three features, as designed in plan.md: config, call state machine in new src/intercom.js, public tablet routes and admin routes, tablet-only SSE notify, noise/location/secure fields on the tablet record, feature flags in /api/config, Permissions-Policy allowing microphone and geolocation for the page itself. Independent of the browser pages, which come in FEAT-002.
steps: src/config.js: add loadIntercom/noise/location settings next to loadCamera (INTERCOM_ENABLED default on, INTERCOM_RING_SECONDS 45 range 10-120, INTERCOM_MAX_MINUTES 10 range 1-60, NOISE_METER default on, NOISE_TALKING_DB -50, NOISE_LOUD_DB -35, LOCATION_REPORT default on) using booleanValue/integerValue/floatValue; talking >= loud turns the noise meter off with a `problem` string like config.camera; expose config.intercom, config.noise, config.location. Add cases to test/config.test.js.

Create src/intercom.js (Node built-ins only, e.g. node:crypto randomBytes): createIntercom({ roomById, config, logger, notifyTablet, now/timers from options }) with one call per room {id, token, roomId, tabletId, state ringing|answered|connected|ended, answeredBy, adminClient, startedAt}; admin stream registry (add/remove, count); ring(roomId, tabletId) returns nobody/busy/cooldown(3 s)/call; answer(callId, clientId, whoText) first wins else 409 with who; relayFromTablet (needs callId+token, only after answered, only to the answering admin client, data capped to 20000 chars, kinds offer|ice|connected); relayFromAdmin (only the answering client, kinds answer|ice); hangup by tablet (token) or admin; timers: ring timeout -> 'unanswered', max length, answering admin stream closing -> ended. Logger lines exactly as in plan.md; never log or store SDP/ICE.

src/server.js: add notifyTablet(roomId, tabletId, type, detail) beside notifyRoom writing only to sseClients whose roomId and tabletId match (never '*'); add a separate adminIntercomClients set. Public routes before the /api/admin/ block: POST /api/intercom/ring, /api/intercom/signal, /api/intercom/hangup (404 when intercom disabled or room unknown, 400 for a missing tabletId/callId, 401-style 403 for a wrong token). Admin routes inside the /api/admin/ block (existing auth, same-origin JSON check for POST already applies): GET /api/admin/intercom/stream?client=<id> (SSE: ready, ring, taken, signal, ended, ping), POST /api/admin/intercom/answer, /signal, /hangup. There is NO admin route that starts a call. Pass options.intercom timing overrides for tests.

src/server.js recordTablet: add `secure` (boolean from body.secure), `noise` ({level in quiet|talking|loud, db integer -120..0, at server time}; explicit null allowed; keep previous when key absent; also `noiseStatus` short string), `location` ({lat -90..90, lon -180..180 rounded to 5 decimals, accuracy integer meters 0..100000, at}; null when absent, with `locationStatus` in denied|unavailable|insecure|timeout), following batteryFrom. Reject out-of-range values to null, not an error (existing behavior must keep working: an older tablet page sends none of these).

src/server.js: change the permissions-policy header to `camera=(), microphone=(self), geolocation=(self)`; add `features: { intercom: config.intercom.enabled, noise: {enabled, talkingDb, loudDb}, location: config.location.enabled }` to the /api/config reply; add `intercom: enabled` per room and `intercomAdminsOnline` to the overview if useful for the dashboard.

Tests: new test/intercom.test.js using the start() helper pattern (copy the helpers it needs or export from a shared place without breaking test/server.test.js). Cover: ring with no admin stream -> nobody and no call; ring with an admin stream -> admin gets 'ring', tablet event only on that tablet's stream and NOT on a room=* stream; admin cannot start a call (POST /api/admin/intercom/ring is 404; no admin route creates a call); signal before answer is refused; wrong token refused; first answer wins, second gets 409 with who; offer relayed only to the answering client, answer only to the tablet; log lines (administrator token and session email forms) and that no log line contains 'sdp' or 'v=0'; ring timeout -> unanswered event; busy and cooldown; hangup from either side; admin stream closing ends the call; non-admin cannot open the stream or answer (401). In test/server.test.js add: heartbeat noise/location/secure stored, bad values dropped, previous kept when absent, overview exposes them; permissions-policy value; /api/config features.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run check` passes including the new tests
No route lets an admin or anyone else start a call except POST /api/intercom/ring, and a call cannot reach 'answered' without that ring
Call data (answer, ICE, callId, state) is never written to the public room=* stream
No log line or stored value contains SDP, ICE or audio
Heartbeats from an older tablet page (no noise/location/secure) still work and change nothing
src/ imports only node: modules or relative files
verification: git status shows only intended files; commit locally on main with a conventional subject (e.g. 'Server: door intercom, noise level and location readings'), never push
findings:
Committed cc7aa8e on main; npm run check: 255 tests pass. API contract for FEAT-002/003:
PUBLIC (no auth): POST /api/intercom/ring {roomId,tabletId} -> 200 {state:'ringing',callId,token,ringSeconds} | 200 {state:'nobody'} | 409 {state:'busy',error} | 429 {state:'cooldown',error} | 404 when intercom off/unknown room | 400 no tabletId. POST /api/intercom/signal {callId,token,kind:'offer'|'ice'|'connected',data} (data string or object, <=20000 chars; 'connected' needs no data; only after answered; 409 before, 403 wrong token, 404 call gone, 413 too big). POST /api/intercom/hangup {callId,token} (idempotent 200 if call gone).
TABLET SSE (/api/stream?room=X&tabletId=T only that tablet; JSON {roomId,detail,at}): event 'intercom' detail {state:'answered'|'ended'|'unanswered',callId,reason?}; event 'intercom.signal' detail {callId,kind:'answer'|'ice',data}. Never on room=*. Tablet-initiated hangup sends no 'ended' back to that tablet.
ADMIN (existing auth; session POSTs need JSON content-type): GET /api/admin/intercom/stream?client=<8-64 chars [A-Za-z0-9_-]> SSE events (data is JSON): ready, ring {callId,roomId,roomName,at}, taken {callId,roomId,who}, signal {callId,roomId,kind:'offer'|'ice'|'connected',data}, ended {callId,roomId,reason}, ping. POST /api/admin/intercom/answer {callId,client} -> 200 {ok,roomId,roomName} | 409 {error,who} | 404 gone | 400 client has no open stream. POST .../signal {callId,client,kind:'answer'|'ice',data}. POST .../hangup {callId,client} (only the answering client, else 403). 404 on everything when INTERCOM_ENABLED is off. Stream closing ends the answered call; last stream leaving ends a ringing call.
/api/config?room=X now has features:{intercom:bool,noise:{enabled,talkingDb,loudDb},location:bool}. Overview: rooms[].intercom bool, top-level intercomAdminsOnline int. Tablet records (in overview rooms[].tablets[]) now carry secure(bool|null), noise{level,db,at}|null, noiseStatus(string), location{lat,lon,accuracy,at}|null, locationStatus('denied'|'unavailable'|'insecure'|'timeout'|''); all undefined for old tablet pages. Heartbeat body keys: secure, noise{level:'quiet'|'talking'|'loud',db number -120..0}, noiseStatus (/^[A-Za-z0-9 ,.-]{1,40}$/), location{lat,lon,accuracy numbers}, locationStatus. Key absent keeps previous; present but invalid -> null.
Log lines as in plan.md ('Intercom: call from <room> started at the door', '... answered by <who>', '... call ended after N s (<reason>)'; reasons: hung up at the door, hung up by <who>, nobody answered, no administrator on the dashboard, timed out, the administrator left the dashboard). A ring with nobody on the dashboard also logs the ended line with 0 s.
Test hooks: options.intercom {ringMs,maxMs,cooldownMs}; server.appState.intercom. Intercom needs the tablet to have an open /api/stream with tabletId to receive events. Docs still to do in FEAT-003: INTERCOM_*, NOISE_*, LOCATION_REPORT in .env.example/INSTALL/README/CHANGELOG. Permissions-Policy now 'camera=(), microphone=(self), geolocation=(self)'. Test helpers in test/intercom.test.js (open/admin/tabletStream) can be reused by e2e thinking. Untracked .agents/ left uncommitted.
